items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. And I'd go with him. And when it wasn't him, I was out with Pee Wee Crayton.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. See, it was my group. I had to keep a band together. So I just made them dates with him, just like I did... See, when I wasn't with him, T-Bone would come in town...
